result.title: Stealthy, High-Impact False Data Injection Attacks in Smart Grid Using Physics-Constrained GAN
result.summary: False data injection (FDI) attacks can distort power system state estimation while retaining plausible measurement patterns. Existing FDI methods trade stealth for impact or vice versa. They often assume access to internal grids, all-bus sensing, or defender models. In this paper, we propose a detector-agnostic physics-constrained generative adversarial network (PCGAN) that learns decoupled power-flow sensitivities from historical measurements of deployed sensors. The learned active-power-angle and reactive-power-voltage-magnitude relationships guide perturbations restricted to compromised channels, while adversarial training promotes realistic spatiotemporal patterns. We implement PCGAN and seven existing FDI attacks on the IEEE 300-bus system using one year of observed hourly demand from PJM Interconnection, a regional transmission organization in the United States, and synthetic bus-level load profiles. We compare their performance across 10%, 30%, 60%, and 100% compromised sensors. Attack stealth is assessed against ten machine-learning (ML) detectors and conventional bad-data detection (BDD) methods, while physical impact is quantified through nonlinear alternating-current weighted least-squares state estimation. PCGAN achieves 84.28% mean ML evasion and 22.31% mean spatial load misperception across the four scenarios. Its mean stealth-impact trade-off score reaches 18.69%, compared with 5.61% for the strongest competing attack. PCGAN also achieves 83.45% chi-square BDD evasion and 86.02% largest-normalized-residual BDD evasion. These results demonstrate a favorable stealth-impact balance under varying sensor-access levels and provide challenging attack cases for evaluating FDI detectors.

AI.brief_summary: 提出物理约束 GAN（PCGAN），从实际部署传感器的历史量测中学习解耦的潮流灵敏度，在受限通道上生成兼具隐蔽性与物理影响的数据注入攻击，并在 IEEE 300 节点系统上对照十种检测器评估其逃逸率与状态估计偏差。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象为电网状态估计的对抗性数据注入与检测逃逸，与视觉/多模态推理中的潜表示、证据获取或停止决策无实质联系；物理约束生成虽属约束性生成建模，但未提供可核查的 LVR 借鉴线索，故排除。
